# Miner

[All quest chapters](index.md)

## Become a Miner

Sea-prism stone is as hard as diamond and drains a Devil Fruit user like the sea itself.

Choose Miner as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Miner

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Miner XP +300

<a id="q-4a6437dc0cd613c3"></a>

## Apprentice Miner

Swing, sort, swing again.

Reach Miner level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Miner](miner.md#q-1bc1cfe0f18c936d)

**Tasks**

- Reach Miner level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Miner XP +800

<a id="q-572243384b4a6c51"></a>

## Journeyman Miner

Find marble, carry an explosive rock out in pieces and mine the stone every pirate fears.

Reach Miner level 25 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Miner](miner.md#q-4a6437dc0cd613c3)

**Tasks**

- Reach Miner level 25
- Mine Kairoseki
- Find Marble
- Break an Explosive Rock safely

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Miner XP +3,000

<a id="q-1220479f7af615bf"></a>

## Expert Miner

Kairoseki comes from Wano. While you are there, shatter a dial and carry a fragment of a fallen star.

Reach Miner level 50 and complete the tasks below.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Miner](miner.md#q-572243384b4a6c51)

**Tasks**

- Reach Miner level 50
- Shatter a dial into fragments
- Carry a Star Fragment
- Land on Wano Country

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Miner XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-4f7ff09f5b7ef780"></a>

## Master Miner

Kairoseki delvers are rare, and well paid.

Reach Miner level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Miner](miner.md#q-1220479f7af615bf)

**Tasks**

- Reach Miner level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
